title: From Umbral Hyperbolic Integrals to a Cotangent Coefficient Formula for the Mittag Leffler Polynomials
summary: Let \(g_n(x)\) be the Mittag--Leffler polynomials defined by $$ \sum_{n\ge0}g_n(x)t^n=\frac12\left(\frac{1+t}{1-t}\right)^x. $$ We derive the coefficient formula $$ g_n(x)=\frac1n\sum_{j=0}^{\lfloor (n-1)/2\rfloor} (-1)^j\frac{2^{n-2j-1}}{(n-2j-1)!} [u^{2j}](u\cot u)^n\,x^{n-2j}, $$ equivalently $$ [u^{n-r}](u\cot u)^n =(-1)^{(n-r)/2}\frac{n(r-1)!}{2^{r-1}}[x^r]g_n(x). $$ The identity is suggested by comparing an umbral representation of the hyperbolic tangent integral $$ K(a,b)=\int_0^\infty \frac{\tanh^a x}{x^b}\,dx $$ with a compact cotangent-coefficient formula, but is proved…
